messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + Mutual Action Plan: Redwood pilot for Acme

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate you taking the time. Quick recap of the key pain points and goals we heard so we’re aligned:

Pain points
- Latency variability during peak traffic (spikes to 400–500ms p95) impacting UX
- Rapidly rising inference costs with current provider; looking to improve unit economics
- Need for a deployment option that satisfies Acme’s data residency and security requirements (VPC/on‑prem options)

Goals for the pilot
- Validate latency SLO: p95 < 150ms for the 99th percentile of target traffic patterns
- Demonstrate cost savings: target < $0.01 per 1k tokens processed on comparable workload (TBD by test prompts)
- Verify integration with Acme’s API gateway + secure networking (no production data persisted outside your VPC)
- Confirm operational controls: auth, audit logs, and rollback/rollback policies for model updates

Mutual Action Plan (draft milestones) — attached as Acme_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx and SOW_draft_Acme.pdf
1) Kickoff & scoping call — target week of Feb 22 (owner: Marissa Cole)
2) Technical workshop (SE-led) — proposed Feb 26 (owner: Vivek Kulkarni) — topics: network setup, sample dataset, integration points, success metrics
3) Pilot configuration & test-run — Mar 1–Mar 14 (owner: Vivek) — deliverable: test harness + baseline latency/cost report
4) Evaluation window — Mar 15–Mar 31 (owner: Acme PM + Redwood) — measure against success criteria
5) Procurement & contract negotiation — target complete by Apr 10 (owner: Acme procurement + Marissa)
6) Decision / go‑no‑go — target Apr 15 (decision committee: product lead, infra, procurement)

Stakeholders we captured
- Acme: Sarah Johnson (Product), Tom Wu (Engineering), procurement TBD
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Vivek Kulkarni (SE), Dylan Brooks (Customer Success)

Open asks / next steps for you
- Please confirm the stakeholders and add procurement/legal contact(s) so we can include them on the timeline
- Confirm the technical workshop date (we proposed Feb 26; happy to move to Feb 27 if that works better)
- Share any security questionnaires in advance so we can prepare relevant docs

We’ve attached the MAP + SOW draft for review. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we confirm dates.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this pilot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0123

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_draft_Acme.pdf

1) Procurement contact: please include Linda Park (linda.park@acme.com) on procurement and contracting threads. She’ll lead commercial review and PO.

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marissa’s note and your ask about security, here’s what we’ll cover in the technical workshop (proposed Feb 27):

Agenda (90 minutes)
- 0–15m: Introductions & high-level pilot goals
- 15–35m: Architecture review — how Redwood routes requests, VPC peering options, and network requirements (eg. IP allowlists, TLS, egress controls)
- 35–60m: Integration demo — sample request flow, auth (token + mTLS options), and how to call the inference endpoint
- 60–80m: Metrics & observability — latency profiling, token cost breakdowns, tracing hooks, and dashboard walkthrough
- 80–90m: Q&A & next steps

Pre-reqs we need from Acme
- Short list (5–10) of representative prompts + estimated RPS (to calibrate load profile)
- Network contact to coordinate IP ranges and firewall rules
- Any security questionnaires in advance so we can pull scoped artifacts

Security items — quick answers
- SOC2: Redwood is SOC2 Type II compliant; we’ll share the report with your security team under NDA.
- Data retention: configurable per-customer; can be set to zero retention for the pilot if required.

I’ve attached a one-page security summary for your procurement/legal team (redwood_security_one_pager.pdf). If Linda could be looped in, we’ll send the SOC2 access instructions and the NDA link.

I’ll prepare the workshop invite for Feb 27 at 10:00 AM PST pending confirmation.

— Vivek
